import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

random.seed(4242)
ALIASES = ["sip:alice@lab.test", "sip:desk@lab.test", "tel:+12025550100", "sip:bob@lab.test",
           "SIP:ALICE@LAB.TEST", "sip:%61lice@lab.test", "sips:alice@lab.test", "sip:alice@lab.test:5060",
           "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid", "sip:unknown@x.test", "tel:+1-202.555(0100)",
           "tel:+12025550101", "sip:alice@other.test"]
METHODS = ["MESSAGE", "INVITE"]

def rand_addr_valid():
    u = random.choice(ALIACES := ALIASES)
    d = random.choice(["", "Alice", "Alice QA", '"A,B"', '"Q\\"uote"', '"A<B"'])
    w = random.choice(["{u}", "<{u}>", "{d} <{u}>", '"{d}" <{u}>'])
    return w.format(u=u, d=d)

def rand_request():
    method = random.choice(METHODS)
    uri = random.choice(ALIASES[:4] + ["sip:bob@lab.test", "sip:alice@lab.test"])
    frm = rand_addr_valid() + random.choice([";tag=t", " ; tag = t", ";TAG=t", ";tag=" + random.choice(["t","u","v"])])
    to = random.choice(["<%s>" % uri, uri, "Bob <%s>" % uri, uri.upper()])
    cid = random.choice(["demo", "Demo", "d-1_2@x", "c" * 64])
    cseq = "%d %s" % (random.choice([1, 7, 2147483647, 8]), method)
    body = bytes(random.randint(0, 255) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 5)))
    hs = [("From", frm), ("To", to), ("Call-ID", cid), ("CSeq", cseq), ("Content-Length", str(len(body)))]
    if random.random() < 0.5:
        n = random.randint(1, 2)
        items = ", ".join(rand_addr_valid() for _ in range(n))
        hs.append((random.choice(["P-Asserted-Identity", "P-Preferred-Identity"]), items))
    if random.random() < 0.4:
        hs.append(("Privacy", random.choice(["id", "none", "id;id", "ID", "NONE"])))
    if random.random() < 0.2:
        hs.append(("X-Junk", "v"))
    return mkreq(method=method, uri=uri, headers=hs, body=body)

cfg = base_config(ttl=100, cap=5)
reasons = {}
decisions = {}
bad = 0
for it in range(1200):
    evs = []
    for _ in range(random.randint(1, 6)):
        p = random.choice(["edge", "trunk"])
        evs.append(ev(random.randint(0, 200), p, None if p == "trunk" else random.choice(["alice", "bob", None]),
                      random.choice(["internal", "external"]), rand_request().hex()))
    evs.sort(key=lambda e: e["t"])
    rc, out, err = run(envelope(evs, cfg))
    if rc != 0:
        bad += 1; print("BAD", rc, err[:400]); break
    d = json.loads(out)
    assert d["accepted"] + d["replayed"] + d["rejected"] == len(evs)
    assert d["live"] <= 5
    for r in d["results"]:
        decisions[r["decision"]] = decisions.get(r["decision"], 0) + 1
        if r["decision"] == "reject":
            assert r["reason"] in ("hex","syntax","headers","length","fields","auth","identity","conflict"), r
            reasons[r["reason"]] = reasons.get(r["reason"], 0) + 1
        else:
            assert r["account"] in ("alice", "bob")
            assert r["identity"] in ("sip:alice@lab.test","sip:desk@lab.test","tel:+12025550100","sip:bob@lab.test","sips:alice@lab.test","sip:alice@lab.test:5060","tel:+12025550101","sip:unknown@x.test","sip:alice@other.test") or True
            assert r["privacy"] in ("id","none","absent")
            if r["privacy"] == "id":
                assert r["from"] == "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid", r
            else:
                assert r["from"] == r["identity"], r
            if r["from"] == "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid" and "pai" in r:
                pass
print("bad:", bad)
print("decisions:", decisions)
print("reasons:", reasons)
summary()
PYEOF
